# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Age:** School-age child (around ten years old in Volume 2)  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** School student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P1](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony Pye is a little boy with a dark, sullen face and black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)_

## Personality

Anthony is an independent, sullen, and mischievous boy who is easily influenced by his family's prejudices. He initially holds female teachers in contempt, believing they are no good, and behaves with an impertinent, defiant swagger. However, he also possesses a stubborn sense of respect for strength or discipline, eventually coming to respect those who stand up to him or discipline him firmly.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P27](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0027), [v2 c7 P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## Traits

- Sullen and impertinent  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- Fighting and physical brawling  <sub>[v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye came to live in Avonlea after being taken in as an orphan nephew by Mr. and Mrs. George Pye. When Anne Shirley began her teaching career at the Avonlea school, Anthony was one of her new pupils and immediately displayed a sullen, defiant attitude toward her because she was a girl. He engaged in various pranks, including mocking Anne, making rude remarks about her hair, and dropping a mouse into her desk drawer. After the mouse incident, Anne lost her temper and gave him a whipping with her pointer. Contrary to her fears, the whipping earned Anthony's respect, and the next day he offered to carry her books and began behaving much better in school. When Anne resigned two years later to attend college, Anthony was so upset that he fought two pitched battles with other boys to vent his feelings, ultimately declaring that Anne was a good teacher after all.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P27](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0027), [v2 c11 P21](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0021), [v2 c11 P25](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0025), [v2 c12 P24](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0024), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
